citation: Blanco, Amieva and Mancillas (2005). The Tonatiuh Software Development Project. ASME International Mechanical Engineering Congress and Exposition, 157-164. Repository: https://github.com/iat-cener/tonatiuh
description: Tonatiuh is the project's Monte Carlo ray tracer for designing and analysing concentrating-solar systems. It contains a graphical scene editor and extensible models for sunlight, geometry and reflective materials. Inputs represent the concentrating system in extended Open Inventor files; outputs are ray-tracing results for optical post-processing. Spatial coverage is the configured optical installation, and sun conditions define the simulated state, not a fixed historical series. Source is free under GPL-3.0, while the README displays separate CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0 content terms. C++ builds depend on Qt, Coin3D and related libraries. A limitation is that refractive-material extensions are described as planned, and older versions had documented geometry and distribution errors. Tonatiuh supports solar-infrastructure design simulations and relates to SolTrace (model-soltrace), another optical solver. The repository cites validation campaigns and a 2005 software paper, but their results were not independently reproduced.
